messages:
tori: hey folks, new user here. followed the quickstart, set REDWOOD_API_KEY and ran the node sample. first generate returned 200, but subsequent calls immediately get 403 with body 'org_unverified_email'. weird race?
leo_dev: can you paste the sample and the exact error body? also were you invited via SSO or signed up directly?
tori: signed up directly. minimal repro: 
```js
// sample.js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'hello' }); // works once
await c.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'again' }); // 403
```
error body: {"status":403, "error":"org_unverified_email", "detail":"owner_email_unverified", "hint":"verify_owner_email"}
jamie_sdk: thanks. interesting: Python SDK returns a typed OnboardingError for this, but the Node SDK currently surfaces the raw body string which is confusing. that's a parity gap.
amina_support: context: we recently tightened onboarding to block more endpoints until the owner's email is verified to reduce automated abuse. occasionally the initial token is issued before verification is complete, so the first call can succeed then subsequent calls are rejected once the verification check runs.
tori: ugh. the UI didn't clearly show an "verify your email to enable API" banner, just a small toast. I assumed the account was fully active.
leo_dev: two immediate fixes: 1) SDK parity — map org_unverified_email to a friendly error across SDKs with actionable text and a docs link; 2) quickstart preflight that calls `GET /orgs/:id/status` or `GET /auth/whoami` to check `email_verified` before making generates and print next steps.
jamie_sdk: filing DEVEX-1407 to add Node SDK mapping and quickstart change. also will include a helper `ensureOnboarded()` in SDK examples that returns a clear error if email not verified.
product-bot: DEVEX-1407 created by jamie_sdk at 2026-03-23T15:20:00Z (epic: onboarding-ease).
tori: is there any local bypass/header for devs? I don't want to add a card just to try the sample.
amina_support: hosted has no bypass for this gate. i'll DM a sandbox token you can use for local testing. for Dedicated/Private customers we can allow relaxed onboarding via config.
leo_dev: also a UX follow-up: product should add an inline CTA on the account page that says "Verify owner email to enable API access" if org_unverified_email would block requests. otherwise people will hit this silent failure.
jamie_sdk: added a tiny snippet to quickstart in my head: 
```js
const ok = await client.preflightOnboarding();
if (!ok) console.error('Owner email not verified. Visit https://app.redwood.ai/account to verify.');
```
amina_support: i'll update the support KB and add a troubleshooting section: "First call works then 403? Check owner email verification and membership propagation."
tori: thanks all. love the fast responses. saved me a lot of confusion. :pray:
